files.test_reports.py:
import sqlite3
import unittest
from reports import export_orders

class ReportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ordered_export(self):
        db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
        db.execute('CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, total INTEGER)')
        db.executemany('INSERT INTO orders VALUES (?, ?)', [(2, 90), (1, 30)])
        self.assertEqual(export_orders(db), [(1, 30), (2, 90)])
